title: Python datetime
test_conventions: Learner code runs first in a fresh namespace. Each test is a Python snippet (assert statements) executed afterwards in the same namespace; the learner's printed output is available to tests as the string variable __stdout__. expected_output comparisons are exact after stripping trailing whitespace on every line. No input(), network or pip. Files may be created in the working directory (an in-memory file system in the browser); use unique file names. The learner's source code is available to tests as the string variable __source__ (use it with ast or substring checks to reject hard-coded answers).

worked_example.code:
from datetime import datetime

new_year = datetime(2020, 1, 1)
print(new_year)
print(new_year.year, new_year.month, new_year.day)
notes: datetime(year, month, day, hour, minute, second): missing time parts default to 0.
Attributes like .year, .month and .day are plain numbers.
notes_tr: datetime(yıl, ay, gün, saat, dakika, saniye): verilmeyen saat parçaları 0 olur.

exercises.code:
from datetime import datetime, date, time

dt = datetime(2019, 12, 5, 7, 30)
print(dt)
print(dt.hour, dt.minute)
print(date(2020, 1, 1))
print(time(10, 30, 50))
exercises.explanation: datetime prints as 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS' (seconds default to 0). .hour and .minute are plain numbers without padding. A date prints only the date, a time only the time.

misconceptions.2019-12-05 7:30\n7 30\n2020-01-01\n10:30: A datetime always prints the time as HH:MM:SS with leading zeros.
misconceptions.2019-12-05 07:30:00\n7 30\n2020-01-01 00: A date object has no time part, so it prints only the date.

exercises.explanation_tr: datetime 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS' biçiminde yazdırılır (saniye varsayılan olarak 0). .hour ve .minute başında sıfır olmayan düz sayılardır. date sadece tarihi, time sadece saati yazdırır.

misconceptions_tr.2019-12-05 7:30\n7 30\n2020-01-01\n10:30: datetime saati her zaman sıfır dolgulu HH:MM:SS biçiminde yazdırır.
misconceptions_tr.2019-12-05 07:30:00\n7 30\n2020-01-01 00: date nesnesinin saat kısmı yoktur, bu yüzden sadece tarih yazdırılır.

worked_example.code:
from datetime import datetime

d = datetime(2019, 12, 5, 1, 5, 1)
print(d.strftime('%d/%m/%Y, %H:%M:%S'))
print(datetime.strptime('5 December, 2019', '%d %B, %Y'))
notes: strftime turns a datetime into text; strptime turns text into a datetime.
%d day, %m month number, %B month name, %Y year, %H hour, %M minute, %S second.
notes_tr: strftime datetime'ı metne çevirir; strptime metni datetime'a çevirir.
%d gün, %m ay numarası, %B ay adı, %Y yıl, %H saat, %M dakika, %S saniye.

exercises.explanation: %m/%d/%Y gives month first: 12/05/2019. %d/%m/%Y gives day first: 05/12/2019. %B is the full month name and %d is zero padded, so 'December 05'.

misconceptions.05/12/2019, 01:05:01\n12/05/2019\nDecemb: %m is the month and comes first in the first format; %d is always zero padded (05).
misconceptions.12/05/2019, 01:05:01\n05/12/2019\nDec 05: %B is the full month name; the short name is %b.

exercises.explanation_tr: %m/%d/%Y önce ayı yazar: 12/05/2019. %d/%m/%Y önce günü yazar: 05/12/2019. %B ayın tam adıdır ve %d sıfır dolguludur, yani 'December 05'.

misconceptions_tr.05/12/2019, 01:05:01\n12/05/2019\nDecemb: İlk biçimde %m ay olarak önce gelir; %d her zaman sıfır dolguludur (05).

worked_example.code:
from datetime import date, timedelta

today = date(2019, 12, 5)
new_year = date(2020, 1, 1)
print(new_year - today)
print(today + timedelta(days=30))
notes: Subtracting two dates gives a timedelta (a length of time).
Adding a timedelta to a date moves the date forward or backward.
notes_tr: İki tarihi çıkarmak bir timedelta (süre uzunluğu) verir.
Bir tarihe timedelta eklemek tarihi ileri ya da geri taşır.

exercises.code:
from datetime import datetime

t1 = datetime(2019, 12, 5, 0, 59, 0)
t2 = datetime(2020, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0)
diff = t2 - t1
print(diff)
print(diff.days)
exercises.explanation: From 5 Dec 00:59 to 1 Jan 00:00 is 26 full days and 23 hours 1 minute. .days gives only the full-days part: 26.

misconceptions.27 days, 0:00:00\n27: t1 is 59 minutes after midnight, so the gap is one hour shorter than a whole 27 days.
misconceptions.26 days, 23:01:00\n27: .days counts only complete days, so it is 26 here.

exercises.explanation_tr: 5 Aralık 00:59'dan 1 Ocak 00:00'a 26 tam gün ve 23 saat 1 dakika vardır. .days sadece tam gün kısmını verir: 26.

misconceptions_tr.27 days, 0:00:00\n27: t1 gece yarısından 59 dakika sonradır, bu yüzden fark tam 27 günden bir saat kısadır.
misconceptions_tr.26 days, 23:01:00\n27: .days yalnızca tamamlanmış günleri sayar, burada 26 olur.

exercises.prompt: In your own words: what are the differences between date, datetime and timedelta?
exercises.prompt_tr: Kendi cümlelerinizle: date, datetime ve timedelta arasındaki farklar nelerdir?
exercises.model_answer: A date holds only year, month and day. A datetime holds the date plus the time of day. A timedelta is not a point in time but a length of time, such as the difference you get when you subtract two dates; you can add it to a date to move it.
exercises.model_answer_tr: date yalnızca yıl, ay ve günü tutar. datetime tarihe ek olarak günün saatini de tutar. timedelta ise bir zaman noktası değil, bir süredir; iki tarihi çıkarınca elde edilen fark gibi. Onu bir tarihe ekleyerek tarihi kaydırabilirsin.

blocks.concept_tr: İki tarihi çıkarınca timedelta (bir süre) elde edersin; bir tarihe timedelta ekleyerek tarihi ileri ya da geri oynatabilirsin.
